spec.name: Duskwatch Arctic Outpost
spec.description: A Firewatch-style flat-colour arctic research outpost at dusk: a stilted teal cabin with warm glowing windows, a red lattice radio tower with a lit beacon, a weather pole, and a gear yard on a sculpted snow diorama base.
spec.layout: A low, wide snow diorama base (about 4.8 x 5.8 m, tallest drifts 0.35 m) carries everything and rests on the floor. The hero sits centre-front: a cabin raised on tall dark stilts (deck top at y 1.9), its teal plank walls cut by big warm-glowing windows and one red door, a steep dark roof with a snow cap, a smoking chimney and a small front porch with steps and a rail; it reads as the warm heart of the scene against the cold palette. Back-right (x ~1.7, z ~-1.7) stands a slender red lattice radio tower 4.4 m tall, the model's tallest silhouette, braced with guy wires, carrying two parabolic dishes, whip antennas and a glowing red beacon at its tip, with a small dark instrument shed and cable trunking at its foot. Left of the cabin (x ~-1.7, z ~0.3) a slim weather pole carries a windsock, spinning anemometer cups and a tilted solar panel. Front-right is the gear yard: stacked crates, red fuel drums, a supply sledge, a shovel and a rope coil, plus a short lantern post whose lantern glows. From front (+Z) to back: gear yard and station steps at the front edge, cabin centre, weather pole left and tower shed right behind the cabin, tower rising at the back. Style: every surface one flat colour in a Firewatch dusk palette — snow in three cool tones lit warm on top, deep teal walls with red-orange trim, dark blue-black roofs and poles, amber window glow and red beacon glow as the only bright notes; shapes are bold and chunky, edges crisp, details (plank lines, trim boards, rivets, flags, footprints) built as small parts in their own colours seated on the big shapes.

parts.builds: The diorama ground: a rounded-corner snow platform slab in snowLit on top and snowShade on sides, with three or four low overlapping snow drifts (flattened spheres or lofted humps) in snowMid and snowShade building a soft skyline around the edges, highest at the back corners. A trampled path in snowShade runs from the front edge to the cabin steps, with a trail of small pressed footprint pairs (tiny flattened dark-snow ellipses in snowShade) marching along it. One or two smooth ice patches (ice) with a thin inkLine rim near the gear yard, a couple of chunky buried boulders in snowShade with ice-glazed tops, and a few scattered small snow lumps. A short wooden boundary signpost at the front-left corner in woodWarm with a small trimRed arrow board pointing at the station. Everything on the base belongs to this part; it holds no buildings, poles or gear.
parts.attaches: Owns the ground plane from y 0 to y ~0.15-0.35 at the drifts; every other part stands on or sinks into it at groundTop; its footprint path lands at the cabin's steps and the gearYard mount.

parts.builds: The hero cabin on stilts. Six chunky dark stiltInk legs with cross-bracing rods run from snow (sunk into drifts) up to the stiltDeck mount at y 1.9, each foot with a small snowShade cap where it enters the snow. On the deck sits the cabin body: teal wallTeal plank walls with thin wallTealDark horizontal plank-seam strips and corner boards, one long side facing +Z with a wide picture window and two side windows — each window a recessed dark frame with a glowing warm glowWarm pane and a thin trimAmber sill, the picture window divided by a mullion cross. A trimRed plank door on the front with woodDark frame, a tiny round porthole window in glowWarm, and a small awning above it. A second smaller rear window. The steep gabled roof is roofInk with a thick snow cap (snowLit slab over the ridge and eaves, little snow lips sagging over the edges) and a woodDark ridge board. A wide stone-grey chimney in stiltInk on the roof ridge with a trimAmber band, from which three chunky flat-colour smoke puffs in smokePale rise and fade to the right. A small front porch at deck level: woodWarm deck boards on two shorter stilts, three plank steps down to the snow path, a woodDark handrail with trimAmber post caps, and a trimRed name board above the door. A tiny trimRed pennant on a short pole at the roof peak. All glowing panes use glowWarm on their own parts.
parts.attaches: Stilt feet sink into snowBase around groundTop; deck sits exactly at the stiltDeck mount; the front steps meet the snowBase footprint path; nothing overlaps the tower or weather pole boxes.

parts.builds: The tallest silhouette: a slim lattice radio tower at x ~1.7, z ~-1.7, standing on three short stiltInk footings sunk into the snow at the towerFoot mount. The tower is a tapering four-post frame in trimRed (Firewatch red-orange) with horizontal cross-braces every rung and X diagonals in steel, narrowing from ~0.5 m square at the base to ~0.22 m at the top, all built from thin rod and box segments. Two thin steel guy wires run from mid-tower down to snow-anchor rings on the base drifts (short dark stakes with ropeTan wire). On the mast: one large parabolic dish (a shallow lathe bowl in snowMid with a dark inkLine rim and a short arm to its feed horn) aimed at the horizon, one smaller dish aimed up-left, two whip antennas (thin steel rods with small trimAmber insulator beads), and a small dark instrument box with a trimAmber stripe lashed to the lattice. At the very tip a steel cross-tree carries a glowing glowRed beacon sphere on a short stem, the model's highest light, plus a tiny red tail antenna. At the foot sits a small instrument shed: a stiltInk box hut with a shallow snow-capped roof, one dark vent slat, a trimRed door strap, and steel cable trunking running up the tower leg. A spare coil of cable leans on the shed wall in ropeTan.
parts.attaches: Footings sink into snowBase at the towerFoot mount; guy wires land on snowBase drifts; the shed's snow cap matches snowBase's snow palette; its box stops short of the mainStation box so the two read side by side behind the cabin.

parts.builds: The weather corner, left of the cabin: one slim tapered steel pole (stiltInk with a trimAmber band at each instrument) rising from a small three-leg snow shoe at the poleFoot mount to y ~2.6. At the top, an anemometer: a tiny steel hub joint (anemoHub) with three flat snowLit rotor cups on short steel arms (each cup its own part on the joint) and a small steel finial. Just below, a wind vane: a flat woodDark arrow with a trimRed tail fin on a horizontal pivot. At y ~1.75 a second joint (windSock) carries a short horizontal arm with a sockOrange windsock: a tapered cone of two flat stripes (sockOrange and snowLit) hanging and streaming backward with a ropeTan hoop at its mouth. Lower on the pole, a tilted solar panel: a steel frame slab in dark inkLine with a grid of cell seams in steel and a glass face in ice, angled toward the sky, on a short strut. A white instrument shelter box (snowLit, louvered slats in snowShade, tiny trimRed latch) hangs at chest height, plus a small steel cable running down the pole into the snow. A short snow-shoveled clearing in snowShade circles the pole foot on the base.
parts.attaches: Pole foot and its snow shoe sink into snowBase at the poleFoot mount; the anemoHub and windSock joints are pre-created at the stated positions and this part builds everything that rides them; its box stays clear of the mainStation and snowBase signpost.

parts.builds: The working yard at the front-right, grounded at the gearYard mount. A stack of three crates: two large woodWarm crates with plank seams in woodDark, steel corner brackets, and a stencil-style trimAmber panel on one face, plus one smaller gearGreen crate on top with a ropeTan rope lashing over it. A leaning pair of red trimRed fuel drums with steel bung caps and a pale snowLit snow cap on the top lid, one drum standing alone half-sunk in a drift. A supply sledge: a long low woodWarm deck with curved woodDark runners, a ropeTan cargo net of crossing straps over two strapped-down duffel shapes in gearGreen and trimAmber, parked at an angle with its nose toward the path. Propped against the crates, a long-handled shovel with a steel blade and woodDark shaft. A short lantern post: a dark stiltInk post with a trimAmber cap, a small steel cross-arm, and a hanging lantern whose glass panes glow warm (glowWarm parts) under a tiny dark roof. A coil of ropeTan rope on the snow, a small stack of three steel supply canisters with trimRed lids, and one dark inkLine ice-core sample tube rack with three pale ice cores sticking up. A small trimRed flag on a short pole marks the yard's corner.
parts.attaches: Everything rests on snowBase inside the gearYard mount area, crates and drums sunk a few centimetres into drifts; the lantern's glow echoes the cabin windows; its box stays clear of the cabin steps and the snowBase footprint path end.
